title: Why Vienna’s coffee houses are a real institution! | Cheers & Chats Ep. 1
speaker: DW Food
zh: 【DW Food】為什麼維也納的咖啡館是一個真正的機構！ |乾杯與聊天EP。 1（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Patrons of authentic Viennese coffeehouses are not only served a cup of coffee and a piece of cake
cues.en: Patrons of authentic Viennese coffeehouses are not only served a cup of coffee and a piece of cake
cues.zh: 正宗維也納咖啡館的顧客不僅可以享用一杯咖啡和一塊蛋糕

cues.text: but also a taste of real Viennese gastronomic culture.
cues.en: but also a taste of real Viennese gastronomic culture.
cues.zh: 還可以品嚐到真正的維也納美食文化。

cues.text: This café is an institution. Here, public figures meet private citizens and tourists.
cues.en: This café is an institution. Here, public figures meet private citizens and tourists.
cues.zh: 這家咖啡館是一個機構。在這裡，公眾人物會見普通公民和遊客。

cues.text: Some only come here for a coffee, others for lunch or dinner.
cues.en: Some only come here for a coffee, others for lunch or dinner.
cues.zh: 有些人只是來這裡喝咖啡，有些人來這裡吃午餐或晚餐。

cues.text: And what part do the around 1000 coffeehouses play in Viennese culture?
cues.en: And what part do the around 1000 coffeehouses play in Viennese culture?
cues.zh: 大約 1000 家咖啡館在維也納文化中扮演什麼角色？

cues.text: The essence of a Viennese coffeehouse is, of course, the coffee.
cues.en: The essence of a Viennese coffeehouse is, of course, the coffee.
cues.zh: 維也納咖啡館的精髓當然是咖啡。

cues.text: But watch out! Here, the espresso, for instance, is called Mokka.
cues.en: But watch out! Here, the espresso, for instance, is called Mokka.
cues.zh: 但要小心！例如，這裡的濃縮咖啡被稱為 Mokka。

cues.text: The Viennese specialties have unique names, as well: the Einspänner is a double espresso with whipped cream.
cues.en: The Viennese specialties have unique names, as well: the Einspänner is a double espresso with whipped cream.
cues.zh: 維也納特色菜也有獨特的名稱：Einspänner 是一種加了鮮奶油的雙份濃縮咖啡。

cues.text: A Viennese Melange is half a cup of coffee with half a cup of steamed cream topped with milk froth.
cues.en: A Viennese Melange is half a cup of coffee with half a cup of steamed cream topped with milk froth.
cues.zh: 維也納混合咖啡是半杯咖啡加半杯蒸奶油，上面撒上奶泡。

cues.text: A Turkish coffee is especially strong, and brewed and served in a Turkish cezve with Turkish honey.
cues.en: A Turkish coffee is especially strong, and brewed and served in a Turkish cezve with Turkish honey.
cues.zh: 土耳其咖啡特別濃，用土耳其蜂蜜沖泡和飲用。

cues.text: In the late 17th century, the Ottoman Turks besieged Vienna for the last time.
cues.en: In the late 17th century, the Ottoman Turks besieged Vienna for the last time.
cues.zh: 17世紀末，奧斯曼土耳其人最後一次圍困維也納。

cues.text: They are thought to have introduced coffee to Austria's capital.
cues.en: They are thought to have introduced coffee to Austria's capital.
cues.zh: 人們認為他們將咖啡引入了奧地利首都。

cues.text: Over the centuries since, a distinctive coffeehouse culture has evolved here.
cues.en: Over the centuries since, a distinctive coffeehouse culture has evolved here.
cues.zh: 幾個世紀以來，這裡逐漸形成了獨特的咖啡館文化。

cues.text: In 2011, UNESCO added it to their list of the world's intangible cultural heritage.
cues.en: In 2011, UNESCO added it to their list of the world's intangible cultural heritage.
cues.zh: 2011年，聯合國教科文組織將其列入世界非物質文化遺產名錄。

cues.text: In addition to the coffee, sweets and pastries are every bit as important.
cues.en: In addition to the coffee, sweets and pastries are every bit as important.
cues.zh: 除了咖啡之外，糖果和糕點也同樣重要。

cues.text: Among the classics are the famous apple strudel Sachertorte cake,
cues.en: Among the classics are the famous apple strudel Sachertorte cake,
cues.zh: 其中經典包括著名的蘋果派薩赫蛋糕，

cues.text: and fine egg-pancakes.
cues.en: and fine egg-pancakes.
cues.zh: 和精美的雞蛋煎餅。

cues.text: These are baked in a pan as thinly as possible and filled with apricot jam for example.
cues.en: These are baked in a pan as thinly as possible and filled with apricot jam for example.
cues.zh: 例如，它們在平底鍋中烤得盡可能薄，並填入杏醬。

cues.text: Then they're rolled up and dusted with powdered sugar.
cues.en: Then they're rolled up and dusted with powdered sugar.
cues.zh: 然後將它們捲起來並撒上糖粉。

cues.text: The waiters – called Herr or Frau Ober – play a key role in any Viennese coffeehouse.
cues.en: The waiters – called Herr or Frau Ober – play a key role in any Viennese coffeehouse.
cues.zh: 服務生——被稱為“Herr”或“Frau Ober”——在任何維也納咖啡館中都扮演著關鍵角色。

cues.text: They are elegantly dressed all in black and white.
cues.en: They are elegantly dressed all in black and white.
cues.zh: 他們穿著優雅的黑白衣服。

cues.text: And what are the tasks they have to master for their job?
cues.en: And what are the tasks they have to master for their job?
cues.zh: 他們的工作必須掌握哪些任務？

cues.text: The café was opened in 1873 by Franz Landtmann.
cues.en: The café was opened in 1873 by Franz Landtmann.
cues.zh: 這家咖啡館由 Franz Landtmann 於 1873 年開設。

cues.text: It's interior is now listed as historically valuable.
cues.en: It's interior is now listed as historically valuable.
cues.zh: 它的內部現在被列為具有歷史價值。

cues.text: An especially precious commodity in a Viennese coffeehouse is time.
cues.en: An especially precious commodity in a Viennese coffeehouse is time.
cues.zh: 在維也納咖啡館裡，一個特別寶貴的商品就是時間。

cues.text: Stylish hospitality and historical ambience: the true soul of Vienna is found in its coffeehouses.
cues.en: Stylish hospitality and historical ambience: the true soul of Vienna is found in its coffeehouses.
cues.zh: 時尚的熱情好客和歷史氛圍：維也納的真正靈魂在於其咖啡館。
